name: Role Feature
summary: Ogryn Role Feature Bulwark While using a slab shield, adjacent allies also gain resistance to damage from opportunity attacks. Gun Lugger Once per turn, your heavy ranged weapon hit deals +1d8 damage. Bone ’ead Allies within 10 ft gain +1 to Wisdom saves while you are conscious. Brute Your melee critical hits knock targets prone if they fail a Strength save.
